diagnosis: Explicit generic full CMG exported and validated the immutable RHS result twice for point/projection and three times for pooled inference. Auxiliary receipt getters replaced r(), causing redundant complete Stata row validation.
fix: Hold the already validated r() result with a tempname while checking auxiliary receipts, then restore it before independent result reconciliation. Limit reuse to explicit already-resolved generic full-CMG requests.
unchanged: benchmark driver, data, seeds, schedule, repetitions and acceptance thresholds

memory_review.ownership: _return hold moves r() and clears the active return namespace; restore moves it back and drops the hold. Tempname ownership releases the object on failed exits.
memory_review.forecast: generic_jla.rs memory_forecast already admits the native result, C row buffer and caller RHS/projection matrices together. Component inference adds its complete allocation bound to that existing command peak, including synchronous export copies. Retaining the caller result during receipt retrieval fits that admitted coexistence; no new result copy is introduced.

local_checks.red: Old candidate fails the new regression with two exports in the first cell.
local_checks.green: Point, projection and pooled fixtures each export once at one/two workers; original-system certificates and idle registry pass.
local_checks.affected: Lifecycle, attachment and controlled full-CMG tests pass at one/two workers, including corruption/cancellation, memory policies and caller restoration.

diagnostic_only.warning: Development observations diagnose overhead; they are not Windows performance acceptance or replacements for the failed confirmation.
